record_type_quote: The direct replication is based on reconstructing the working dataset using an alternative data source (IPUMS CPS) and recoding the regressions.

targets.title: Why Don’t Firms Hire Young Workers During Recessions?
targets.evidence_quote: We present a replication study of the main empirical results of Forsythe (2022).
targets.outcome_computational_quote: We replicate the original results very closely. Our estimated coefficients for the main regressions have the same sign, significance, and magnitude (Table 1, 2, and B.2). We also find very similar results for the other tables despite minor differences that can be reasonably attributed to our alternative dataset construction procedure.
targets.outcome_robustness_quote: These extensions mildly reduce the magnitude of the main effects of interest, but these remain highly significant, leaving the main conclusions of the original study unchanged.
targets.outcome_reasoning: Same underlying CPS survey data reconstructed via IPUMS, rather than an independently collected sample, supports reproduction classification. Comparable coefficients are recovered but differ beyond rounding, with changed matching rules and sample counts. Authors regard substantive conclusions as unchanged. Computation code is uncertain because authors emphasize close recovery rather than exact numbers; robustness is explicit.
